_meta.name: scale_reliability
_meta.description: Scale reliability of a three-measure battery on experiment.pulse (revenue_before, revenue, session_minutes): Cronbach's alpha and standardized alpha, McDonald's omega from a one-factor minres fit, the mean inter-item correlation, and per item the corrected item-total r, alpha if deleted, mean and sd, with the inter-item correlation matrix as primary. On a rating battery, params.reverse with scale_min / scale_max flips reverse-worded items (x' = min + max - x) before the fold. Omega is null with a warning on 2 items, a Heywood fit or an unrepaired non-PSD pairwise input; here session_minutes does not belong with the two revenue measures (alpha if deleted jumps to 0.98), so the fit is a Heywood case and omega comes back null with PULSE_MATRIX_HEYWOOD. Streamable and mergeable; no p-values.
